name: Biscayne National Park
policyReason: Pets may visit only the Convoy Point grounds and developed areas of Elliott Key; no trails are open to them.
summary: Leashed pets may visit the Convoy Point grounds and developed areas on Elliott Key, but not Boca Chita Key.

excerpts.quote: On Elliott Key pets on a leash are permitted within developed areas only.

dogRules.text: Not allowed on Boca Chita Key, including boats docked in its harbor.
Never leave pets in a parked car.
